# Citexa-AI

> Citexa-AI helps businesses get recommended by AI search engines such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Microsoft Copilot and Google AI Overviews. We check what these tools say when customers ask for a recommendation, find the gaps on a business's website (schema markup, FAQs, business details), and help fix them. This practice is called Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).

## Core Navigation
- [Home Page](https://www.citexa.online): What Citexa-AI does and how the process works.
- [Services](https://www.citexa.online/services): AI visibility checks, website readiness reviews, schema markup, FAQ optimization, business listing reviews, competitor comparisons and monthly re-checks.
- [Pricing](https://www.citexa.online/pricing): Free AI visibility check; one-time AI Visibility Report (₹2,999) or AI Visibility Audit + Fix (₹14,999); Monthly Starter (₹2,499/month) or Monthly AI Visibility Monitoring (₹7,499/month).
- [About Us](https://www.citexa.online/about): Our mission and team. Founded by Ajay Adhikari.
- [Free AI Visibility Check](https://www.citexa.online/audit): Request a free, manual check of whether AI search engines recommend your business.
- [Contact](https://www.citexa.online/contact): Send a message or book a 15-minute call.
- [Blog](https://www.citexa.online/blog): Guides on Answer Engine Optimization and schema markup.
